123cdxcc-dsh-mindsee.reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to let DeepSeek process and understand screenshots/local images via MindSee (image-to-text description for chat questions), which is fundamentally an image/media capability with an external service integration.

1274623767-dsh-workspace-open.reason: The plugin augments the left workspace sidebar by adding a folder button per workspace row and opens the corresponding path in the system file manager, so it is primarily a navigation/panel UI enhancement for workspace management.

1321928757-dsh-prompt-polish.reason: It is mainly a composer utility that provides a one-click **Optimize** action to rewrite and improve user prompt drafts (with optional session context), i.e., a general prompt-engineering assistant in the chat input flow.

13323232dong-dsh-tunnel-qr-plugin.reason: The plugin’s primary purpose is to expose DeepSeek Harness via a Cloudflare public tunnel and provide a QR-code entry point for easy one-time remote login, including tunnel process management and connection token handling, which is fundamentally an external service integration with a UI overlay.

1710782766-dsh-llm-vision.reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is image/media understanding: it provides describe_image and extract_text tools (including OCR) for screenshots and documents in DeepSeek Harness, with options for image input handling, preprocessing, retries, and cached results via vision endpoints.

189-sketch-dsh-custom-logo.reason: The plugin’s main function is user-facing UI customization: replacing the default DSH top-left brand wordmark with custom logo/text and providing inline visual controls in the interface, which is fundamentally a themes/layout customization feature.

1helloman1-dsh-vision-fallback.reason: The plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is to make chat image inputs work with text-only models by automatically sending attached images to a vision model and returning the vision observations as hidden context for the main model, while keeping images visible in the UI.

1mlightyears-dsh-theme-synthwave.reason: The plugin’s core function is to provide a Synthwave visual theme for the DSH web interface, including glowing tokens, translucent panels, configurable backgrounds (image/video), blur, and font scaling, which are all interface appearance/layout changes.

21hbguo-dsh-thinking-counter.reason: This plugin’s user-facing feature is a web UI panel that continuously collects reasoning/thinking messages from running sessions, matches user-defined phrases, and displays counts, hit logs, ratios, and status visuals (including a progress indicator) in a floating/sidebar interface.

4sa1ary9-dockyard-dsh.reason: The plugin’s user-facing purpose is adding and managing external model-provider accounts (Codex, Grok, Claude, Cursor, Antigravity) inside DeepSeek Harness via login/import, provider switching, and credential handling.

4sa1ary9-dsh-everything-oauth.reason: The plugin’s core purpose is connecting DeepSeek Harness to external AI services (Codex, Grok, Claude) via OAuth and local token import/login flows, including provider authentication status and token-based access management.

4t145-dsh-lark-connector.reason: Primary purpose is connecting DeepSeek Harness to Feishu/Lark as an external messaging service: it receives/sends chat messages via Lark/Feishu credentials and sync tools, with a web page for connection and session configuration.

534119219-chicheng-peak.reason: This plugin is primarily a reminder tool that detects peak/valley periods and sends timely alerts via local browser notifications or external push channels, with the animated border shown as a supplementary notification-style indicator.

534119219-chicheng-quickinput.reason: This plugin’s primary user-facing purpose is a chat-input side utility panel: it adds a quick button beside the input controls, opens a vault panel with categorized entries, supports clicking to fill/send, searching, and in-panel management (add/edit/delete), which is fundamentally about in-app panel navigation and input assistance rather than code generation, testing, or other non-UI tooling.

534119219-dsh-custom-provider-reasoning.reason: The plugin’s core purpose is to adapt custom provider routes to external model APIs: it auto-injects/normalizes reasoning metadata and compatibility settings so custom LLM providers can expose and use reasoning effort correctly across OpenAI/Anthropic-compatible endpoints.

7dgroup-ai-dsh-skill-7d-git-commit.reason: The plugin adds a DeepSeek skill that automatically handles git commit-message generation and validation in the user workflow, enforcing convention rules and prompting/fixing violations before commit.

ymh0000123-dsh-theme-endfield.reason: The plugin is a DeepSeek Harness web theme that overrides tokens, injects global styles (colors, typography, rounded-corner removal), and adds watermark/UI option toggles to alter the app’s visual style and layout appearance.
